name: looking_at
summary: What the player's crosshair is on: the thing the 3 m interaction ray hits and where a longer look ray lands. include adds the player, the button or slot under it, the view, the full hit and the body. Read only.

help.text: Returns target (null for nothing, terrain or past 3 m) and hit {point, distance_m, face, thing}. include adds parts: player, interactable, view, hit (the full hit), body (a structure target's body), or all. A part asked for that is empty (no interactable, no hit) is left out. Hand target.reference_id to any other tool. Needs the player's view.
help.keys: target {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, custom_name, kind, ...}, hit {point, distance_m, face, thing}, player {reference_id, display_name, position}, interactable {action, display_name, contextual_name, state, slot}, view {eye, forward, right, up, yaw_deg, ...}.

target.text: target {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name, custom_name, kind (item, dynamic: a movable thing that is not an item, structure, entity, other), runtime_type, position, distance_m, is_device (logic tools take it), has_atmosphere, parent (the holder of a thing in a slot)}. A structure adds rotation {facing, up, euler} in the forms place_structure takes (facing and up null when turned off the grid's axes) and facing_me; with include body, body {origin, render_box, centre_offset, grid_box, grid_cells}.

interactable.summary: The button, switch, port or slot under the crosshair.
interactable.text: interactable (include interactable): left out when none, else what the hand would use: {action (Activate, OnOff, Open, Slot1...), display_name, contextual_name (the tooltip name), state, slot {slot_index, slot_name, occupant}}.

view.summary: The camera: eye, axes, yaw and pitch.
view.text: view (include view) {eye, forward, right, up, yaw_deg (0 along +z, 90 +x), pitch_deg (up positive), source (local or remote), age_s, axes {forward, right, up, back, left, down: the world axes nearest the player's level heading, so a metre forward runs along the floor; look: the axis nearest the look itself}, ambiguous (heading within 10 degrees of a diagonal), third_person, seated}.

hit.summary: The longer look ray: point, face, cells.
hit.text: hit casts the same ray up to max_distance_m (default 10, max 50), left out when it hits nothing: {point, distance_m, face, thing}; include hit adds normal, face_plane ("z=668" when within 0.3 m of a 2 m face plane), cell_2m (on your side), small_cell (where a piece mounted there would stand), support (grid_survey's support letter), local_on_target {right_m, up_m, forward_m}}.

max_distance_m.description: How far hit casts the look ray; default 10, max 50.

include.description: Parts to add: player, interactable, view, hit (the full hit), body, or all. Default none.
